description: This file defines a C# class 'ConsumerEventCountingGrain' implementing an Orleans grain for counting consumed stream events, including methods for activation, deactivation, subscribing to streams, and handling stream events.

classes.name: ConsumerEventCountingGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class that counts the number of stream events received, manages stream subscriptions, and handles activation/deactivation lifecycle.

classes.name: AsyncObserver<T>
classes.description: A private nested class implementing IAsyncObserver<T> to handle incoming stream events asynchronously.

methods.name: ConsumerEventCountingGrain
methods.description: Constructor initializing the logger for the grain.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, initializes counters and subscription handle.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain deactivation, stops consuming streams and resets counters.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain to a specified stream using a stream provider.

methods.name: EventArrived
methods.description: Handles incoming stream events, increments counter, and logs the event.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Unsubscribes from the stream and cleans up resources.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns the total number of stream events consumed.
